annotation.authors_or_issuer: Hamon, R.; Junklewitz, H.; Sanchez, I.
annotation.summary_en: JRC technical report reviewing the robustness and explainability of AI/machine learning, covering transparency, interpretability, reliability, adversarial vulnerabilities and data protection. It links technical solutions to policy options, including certification of AI robustness and standards, in the context of EU policymaking.
key_provisions_or_claims: Reviews interpretability approaches and the interpretability-accuracy trade-off
Describes ML vulnerabilities: data poisoning, adversarial examples, model flaws
Presents ways to improve reliability: data sanitization, robust learning, extensive testing, formal verification
Discusses privacy-preserving techniques: differential privacy, federated learning, encrypted training
Proposes certification of AI robustness as a bridge from technical to policy solutions
annotation.title_clean: Robustness and Explainability of Artificial Intelligence: From technical to policy solutions
annotation.title_en: Robustness and Explainability of Artificial Intelligence: From technical to policy solutions
annotation.venue: Publications Office of the European Union (JRC Technical Report EUR 30040)
